title: Element Node (V4 atomic OR V3 classic)
description: FROZEN canonical authoring node. Two node schemas coexist in the same tree (RESEARCH.md §2.1, §4). V4 atomic (elType 'e-*' container or widgetType 'e-*') is the PRIMARY target; V3 classic (section/column/container + classic widgets) is the FALLBACK. TS type names: ElementNode = AtomicNode | ClassicNode; AtomicContainerNode, AtomicWidgetNode, ClassicNode (WP-F03). The PHP dry_run validator (WP-P03) is AUTHORITATIVE: unknown legacy elTypes/widgetTypes are SILENTLY DROPPED on save; unknown/invalid atomic nodes THROW and abort the whole save (has-atomic-base.php:97,113). This schema is a structural pre-filter only.

ElementId.description: Node id. Minted by TS as substr(strtolower(dechex(wp_rand)),0,7) (7 hex chars; NOT a UUID). Elementor performs NO server-side uniqueness check (controls-stack.php trusts id verbatim) — the MCP MUST guarantee uniqueness across the whole tree and against existing document ids. Duplicates collide on .elementor-element-<id> selectors and break CSS.

AtomicTag.description: Container tag prop. enum for e-div-block/e-flexbox: div,header,section,article,aside,footer,a,button (div-block.php:52). For e-heading: h1..h6. For e-paragraph: p,span.

AtomicContainerNode.description: V4 atomic container (extends Atomic_Element_Base). Serializes WITHOUT widgetType. Carries sibling keys version/styles/editor_settings/interactions in addition to settings/elements. settings values are TypedValue envelopes. styles is a map of local StyleDefinition keyed by id; every local style id MUST also be present in settings.classes.value.

elType.description: Atomic container element type. Verified set from modules/atomic-widgets/elements/.

settings.description: Map of prop name -> TypedValue (generic envelope; the loose pre-filter check). ALWAYS includes classes (Classes envelope, default empty). Auto-injected _cssid (string, ignorable) may appear on round-trip; tolerate but do not author. STRICTER PRE-FILTER (optional, WP-T prefilter.ts): substitute the strict per-$$type defs from atomic-prop-types.schema.json (e.g. #/$defs/Image, #/$defs/ImageSrc which enforces id-XOR-url, #/$defs/Size, #/$defs/HtmlV3, #/$defs/Classes) keyed by the per-widget prop map from authoring-contract §4.1. The PHP dry_run validator (WP-P03) is authoritative for all nested/conditional rules either way.

styles.description: Local style objects keyed by style id (e-<elementId>-<7hex>). Each id MUST also appear in settings.classes.value.

editor_settings.description: Editor-only metadata; array or object. Often holds {title} label or the idempotency op_id (hidden).

interactions.description: Animation/behavior interactions. Envelope confirmed; full item schema UNVERIFIED (RESEARCH.md §10 OQ#10). Default [].

AtomicWidgetNode.description: V4 atomic widget (extends Atomic_Widget_Base). Serializes elType:'widget' + widgetType:'e-*'. Same sibling keys as containers. elements is typically empty.

widgetType.description: Atomic widget type. Verified set from modules/atomic-widgets/elements/ + Pro atomic forms (gated on e_pro_atomic_form) + the e-component instance widget (modules/components, gated on e_components, Elementor 4.2+).

ClassicNode.description: V3 classic node (FALLBACK). section/column/container element, or any classic widget. settings is a FLAT assoc map of scalar/object control values (NO typed envelopes). Responsive overrides use SUFFIX keys (_tablet/_mobile), never nested objects. Group controls expand to flat prefixed keys. Switcher = 'yes'/''. Dynamic via settings.__dynamic__[ctrl]; globals via settings.__globals__[ctrl]. Emit only non-default keys.

widgetType.description: Required when elType=='widget'. Classic widget slug (e.g. heading, text-editor, image, button). MUST NOT start with 'e-' (that is the atomic namespace; atomic widgets use AtomicWidgetNode). Unknown slugs are SILENTLY DROPPED on save.

settings.description: Flat control-value map. Reserved keys: __dynamic__ (map ctrl->elementor-tag shortcode), __globals__ (map ctrl->'globals/...?id=...'). Other keys are control names; values scalar (Base_Data_Control) or object (Base_Multiple: media/url/icons/slider/dimensions/box_shadow).

__dynamic__.description: ctrl -> '[elementor-tag id=".." name=".." settings="<urlencoded JSON_FORCE_OBJECT>"]'. Empty settings encode as %7B%7D, NOT empty string.

__globals__.description: ctrl -> 'globals/colors?id=<_id>' or 'globals/typography?id=<_id>'. Typography group key is typography_typography.

ElementNode.description: Discriminated union over all node kinds. A subtree MAY mix generations but test nesting (RESEARCH.md §4.5 rule 6). TS: type ElementNode = AtomicContainerNode | AtomicWidgetNode | ClassicNode. Discrimination is deterministic so each node routes to exactly ONE branch (the loose ClassicNode never absorbs atomic shapes): an atomic container elType ('e-*' except 'widget') -> AtomicContainerNode; elType 'widget' with an atomic 'e-*' widgetType -> AtomicWidgetNode; everything else -> ClassicNode. This lets the pre-filter enforce strict atomic sub-rules (e.g. image-src XOR) instead of falling through to additionalProperties:true. PHP dry_run remains authoritative.
